newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: SOCCER-NYILAS SPURS HUNGARY TO CONVINCING VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NYILAS SPURS HUNGARY TO CONVINCING VICTORY.

text.p: Two goals from Ferencvaros midfielder Elek Nyilas thrust Hungary to a 3-0 victory over Azerbaijan in their World Cup European group three qualifying match on Sunday.
Hungary dominated the first half, with Belgian-based midfielder Florian Urban dictating play.
They seized the lead in 43rd minute when Nyilas cut in from the right and drove a powerful, 16-metre shot past goalkeeper Zidkov.
Hungary extended their lead when Urban was brought down and Nyilas converted the penalty in the 67th minute.
The impressive Urban wrapped up Hungary's second group win in three games with a goal from close range after 78 minutes.
